title: Technology Sector Update for 01/29/2018: MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG, DST, CYOU, SOHU, MOMO
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +1.1%
AAPL: -0.8%
IBM: -0.2%
CSCO: -0.3%
GOOG: -0.1%
Technology shares were mostly lower in Monday's pre-market trading .
Expected movers:
- DST Systems ( DST ): said Q4 EPS rose 33.7% year over year while revenue topped Street views
- Changyou.com ( CYOU ): reports lower-than-expected Q4 results
- Sohu.com ( SOHU ): fell more than 9% after reporting Q4 loss and revenue below Street expectations
Other news:
- Momo ( MOMO ): jumped more than 3% after JP Morgan upgraded shares to overweight from neutral
